purpose: Staking yield farm for phUSD. Verbatim copy of PhlimboV2 (stake/withdraw/claim + migrator role + hook + fixed linear-depletion rate-recompute) PLUS an additive SINGLE promotional-reward-token subsystem with a pause->flush->rotate state machine (story-023 family: promo slot + history-free rotation).

verifiedProperties.noUnboundedLoops: verified — the only loop (batchClaim) is chunked by maxIterations with a monotone flushCursor; seed/iteration bounds are owner/permissionless-chunked, never single-tx-unbounded
verifiedProperties.checkedArithmetic: verified — Solidity 0.8.19, no unchecked blocks, no assembly
reentrancyUNGuarded_stateChanging: pauseWithdraw (whenPaused only; no external call before state writes except final phUSD transfer)
verifiedProperties.pauseMechanism: yes — Pausable; owner OR pauser may pause/unpause; unpause blocked while promoPhase==Flushing
verifiedProperties.weakRandomness: none — no block/tx entropy driving value outcomes
verifiedProperties.promoDebtRealignmentOnPauseWithdraw: verified — pauseWithdraw realigns phUSDDebt/stableDebt/promoDebt to the reduced amount, fixing the latent V1/V2 partial-pauseWithdraw underflow-brick
verifiedProperties.accPromoPerShareNeverReset: verified — finalizePromotion clears promoToken/balances but retains accPromoPerShare; all debts aligned by flush so next promo starts pending==0 (prevents amount*acc-debt underflow)
verifiedProperties.flushCompleteness: verified-by-construction — set membership mutates only in whenNotPaused ops; beginFlush pauses; finalizePromotion requires flushCursor==_stakers.length()
verifiedProperties.minStakeInvariant: verified — stake requires amount>=MINIMUM_STAKE(1e15); withdraw dust-rule forces full exit when remaining<MINIMUM_STAKE, so any nonzero position is always >=MINIMUM_STAKE; _stakers membership <=> amount>0

localFindings.description: _tryTransfer treats `callSuccess && (returndata.length==0 || abi.decode(returndata,(bool)))` as success. A promo token whose transfer returns NON-empty returndata shorter than 32 bytes causes abi.decode to REVERT, which propagates and bricks the batchClaim chunk — defeating the whole point of the non-reverting try-transfer (flush must never brick). Owner-vetted partner token mitigates; flag for token-assumption review.
localFindings.recommendation: Length-check returndata (>=32) before decoding, or treat any non-standard returndata as failure and bank into unclaimablePromo.

localFindings.description: A user who pauseWithdraws to amount==0 is NOT removed from _stakers (by design — set frozen during pause). They persist as a zero-amount 'phantom' member until their next whenNotPaused withdraw removes them. Harmless to correctness (flush visits them with pending==0) but inflates stakerCount and adds flush iterations.
localFindings.recommendation: None required; document that stakerCount can exceed active stakers.

localFindings.description: accPromoPerShare += (promoToDistribute*PRECISION)/totalStaked can round to 0 when totalStaked is large and per-tick promo small, stranding promo in the contract (standard MasterChef rounding). Swept to leftoverRecipient at finalizePromotion, so no permanent loss to protocol.
localFindings.recommendation: Accept; note that dust accrues to leftoverRecipient not stakers.

externalEntryPoints.notes: auto-claim routes to msg.sender (caller), NOT user — migrator-delegation semantics
principal + rewards to msg.sender; dust-rule may force full exit
pays promo DIRECTLY to each staker (not caller-routed)

externalCalls.trustLevel: trusted-mintable — V3 must hold mint role; phUSD is protocol token
externalCalls.notes: reward phUSD is MINTED (unbacked emission gated by desiredAPYBps, owner-set)
assumed standard ERC20, no fee-on-transfer; if USDC-like with blocklist, a frozen staker's stable claim reverts their stake/withdraw/claim path
fee-on-transfer explicitly rejected at startPromotion/topUp via balance-delta check; must never be phUSD or rewardToken (enforced)

methods: calls stake/withdraw/claim on behalf of users
externalCalls.notes: auto-claimed rewards route to migrator, forwarded on by migrator

stateVariables_key.name: accPromoPerShare
stateVariables_key.invariant: MONOTONE, never reset; all promoDebts aligned to it at each flush

stateVariables_key.name: _stakers (EnumerableSet)
stateVariables_key.invariant: membership <=> amount>0, mutates only whenNotPaused; frozen during flush

stateVariables_key.name: promoPhase
stateVariables_key.invariant: None|Active|Flushing state machine; unpause blocked in Flushing

stateVariables_key.name: flushCursor
stateVariables_key.invariant: monotone within a flush; finalize requires ==_stakers.length()

trustAssumptions: phUSD grants mint role to this contract; phUSD reward emission is UNBACKED mint gated only by owner-set desiredAPYBps (owner-trusted for the APY magnitude).
rewardToken is a standard ERC20 stablecoin, no fee-on-transfer. If it enforces a blocklist (USDC/USDT), a frozen staker cannot claim their stable and their stake/withdraw/claim path reverts.
promoToken is owner-vetted per promotion, non-fee-on-transfer (enforced), and is not phUSD/rewardToken (enforced).
hook (if set) is trusted and non-reverting on the happy path; called after state finalization.
Owner runs the promo state machine correctly (beginFlush -> drive batchClaim to completion -> finalizePromotion -> unpause). abortFlush is always safe.
leftoverRecipient at finalize is a receivable address.
suspiciousAreas_forTier2: SHARED lastRewardTime across stable/phUSD/promo: startPromotion/topUp/setPromoDepletionDuration each call _updatePool first, but verify no path lets promo accrue over a window before the promo existed, and that a Active->dormant(depleted)->topUp reactivation does not double-count the dormant gap.

collectReward is PERMISSIONLESS and recomputes rewardPerSecond = rewardBalance*PRECISION/depletionDuration on every call — a griefer can repeatedly collect 1 wei to reset/dilute the depletion rate mid-window (also applies to V2). Confirm economic impact.

batchClaim permissionless during Flushing: reads frozen accPromoPerShare snapshot — confirm no interleaving with any non-paused promo accrual. Also _tryTransfer malformed-returndata revert (V3-LOCAL-01) can brick the flush chunk.

Cross-contract reentrancy via rewardToken/promoToken transfer callbacks during _claimRewards (transfers occur before debt writes within stake, though nonReentrant guards the entry) — all core entries are nonReentrant, but pauseWithdraw is only whenPaused; verify no ERC777-style reentry path.

emergencyTransfer sweeps ALL balances (incl. promo mid-Active) and pauses but does NOT touch promoPhase/promoRewardBalance bookkeeping — after emergencyTransfer during Active/Flushing the promo accounting is stale vs. zero on-hand balance; confirm no stuck state / underflow on subsequent finalize.
desiredAPYBps has no upper bound — phUSDPerSecond scales linearly; owner footgun for runaway phUSD mint (owner-trusted, likely QA).
